# dodopayments_webhook (Data Source)

Reads one webhook by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dodopayments_webhook" "example" {
  url = "https://example.com/example-webhook"
}

data "dodopayments_webhook" "example" {
  id = dodopayments_webhook.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The webhook's ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Created at timestamp.
- `description` (String) An example webhook name.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Status of the webhook.

If true, events are not sent.
- `filter_types` (Set of String) Filter events to the webhook.

Webhook event will only be sent for events in the list.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata of the webhook.
- `rate_limit` (Number) Configured rate limit.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at timestamp.
- `url` (String) Url endpoint of the webhook.
